Bus Drivers, Transit And Intercity operate buses on established routes and schedules. They follow traffic and safety rules, transport passengers, protect boarding and exiting, inspect vehicles, announce stops, handle fares, and respond to incidents as frontline drivers and service workers in public transit.

paragraphs: Begin before dawn with a walk-around inspection and schedule check. During rush hour, follow the route on time through traffic while making stop announcements and reminding passengers to offer seats. Rest and eat during the midday off-peak period. In the afternoon, slow down or detour around construction and incidents. At the end of service, inspect the bus and complete records, leaving only after parking safely at the depot.

In one sentence: transport a busload of passengers safely and on time along a route. Work includes driving, routine inspections, stop announcements, fare handling, emergency response, and records. It requires managing road conditions, passengers, and service.
